lassocox_cardiovascular: example dataset for the jsurvival module

Source: R/data_lassocox_cardiovascular.R
lassocox_cardiovascular.Rd

Example dataset distributed with the jsurvival jamovi module for demonstration and testing.

Usage

lassocox_cardiovascular

Format

A data frame with 150 rows and 19 variables:

subject_id

character variable

time_to_event_months

numeric variable

cv_event

factor variable

age_years

numeric variable

gender

factor variable

race_ethnicity

factor variable

bmi_kg_m2

numeric variable

systolic_bp_mmhg

numeric variable

diastolic_bp_mmhg

numeric variable

total_cholesterol_mg_dl

numeric variable

hdl_cholesterol_mg_dl

numeric variable

ldl_cholesterol_mg_dl

numeric variable

diabetes_mellitus

factor variable

hypertension

factor variable

smoking_status

factor variable

family_history_cvd

factor variable

ace_inhibitor_use

factor variable

statin_use

factor variable

aspirin_use

factor variable
